pull.title: feat: My Claude Code 5.0 — complete rebrand from Free Claude Code (#82)
pull.body:
## What changed

Rebrand the entire product from Free Claude Code (FCC) to My Claude Code (MCC).
This is a coordinated major release touching package identity, command family,
UI, docs, GitHub surfaces, themes, and analytics. Legacy contracts are preserved
so existing users, configs, and clients keep working.

### Package & namespace

- Rename `src/free_claude_code/` to `src/my_claude_code/` (git mv preserves history).
- Add `src/free_claude_code/__init__.py` compat shim that re-exports `my_claude_code`,
  so legacy imports still resolve.
- `pyproject.toml`: `name="my-claude-code"`, version 5.0.0, packages include both
  roots, all `[project.scripts]` point at `my_claude_code` implementations.
- `core/version.py`: owner-aware `package_version()`/`distribution_name()` try native
  distribution first, fall back to legacy.
- `core/identity.py`: neutral `ToolOwner` model (`LEGACY_OWNER`/`NATIVE_OWNER`) with
  command/distribution/display-name mapping.
- All first-party imports updated across `src/` and `tests_`.
- `tests/contracts/test_import_boundaries.py` updated for `my_claude_code`.

### Dual command families (both work identically)

- **Native**: `mcc-server`, `my-claude-code`, `mcc-init`, `mcc-claude`, `mcc-claude-old`,
  `mcc-codex`, `mcc-pi`, `mcc-chatgpt-oauth-login`, `mcc-compact-log`.
- **Legacy**: `fcc-server`, `free-claude-code`, `fcc-init`, `fcc-claude`, `fcc-claude-old`,
  `fcc-codex`, `fcc-pi`, `fcc-chatgpt-oauth-login`, `fcc-compact-log`.
- `--version` derives the label from `owner_for_invocation()`.

### UI rebrand (strings only; contracts untouched)

- `index.html`: title, brand mark "MC", headings, prose.
- `admin.js`: localStorage keys (`mcc-version-dismissed-*`), download filenames
  (`mcc-websearch-*`, `mcc-requests-*`), log/error/help text.
- 13 launcher/config/admin files: user-facing prose.

### Themes & dashboard

- `admin.css`: `[data-theme="paper"]` (true light) and `[data-theme="high-contrast"]`
  (WCAG AAA) semantic-token blocks.
- `index.html`: theme switcher (Midnight / Paper / High Contrast) in sidebar.
- `admin.js`: `applyTheme`/`initThemeSwitch` + `chartRedrawers` registry so token-driven
  canvases re-theme on switch.

### Brand system & docs

- `docs/BRAND.md`: source of truth.
- `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/USAGE.md`.
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*` + validator: accept both legacy FCC and new MCC forms.
- `docs/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md`: dual-repo mirroring plan.

### Analytics

Verified pulse-based 5s heartbeat, no dual-axis charts, semantic series colors,
request-log data tables preserved.

### Legacy contracts preserved (unchanged)

`FCC_*` env vars, `FCC_ENV_FILE`, `freecc` token, `:8082` port, `.fcc` dir,
`FiredMosquito831/free-claude-code` RELEASE_REPO, `fcc` Codex provider id,
`free-claude-code/**` Pi scope, `claude-3-freecc-*` model ids, legacy command names.

## Verification

- Targeted suite: 31 passed (`tests/contracts/test_import_boundaries.py`, `tests/test_brand_contract.py`).
- `ruff format --check`, `ruff check` clean on all changed files.
- Built `my_claude_code-5.0.0-py3-none-any.whl` (digest `sha256:d385b2b...`); installed
  in isolated uv tool dir; all 18 executables present; version reporting correct.

## Residual risks

1. Repo URLs unchanged (`FiredMosquito831/free-claude-code`) — by design; the
   product/command family rebrands, the GitHub slug does not.
2. Brand mark is text "MC", not the specified route glyph SVG — a follow-up design task.
3. Canvas charts have `role="img"`+`aria-label` but not full numeric companion tables.
4. New themes not yet visually verified in a browser (pending this review).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

fix(v5): CI failures in branding PR

- Compat shim: use module-level __getattr__ instead of re-exporting
  __all__/identity/version (fixes ty unresolved-import errors).
- ARCHITECTURE.md: update all src/free_claude_code/ paths to my_claude_code/.
- pyproject.toml: drop free_claude_code from known-first-party (compat shim
  has no isort needs).
- Workflow versionPattern: fix regex grouping so the None alternative and
  anchors apply to the whole expression.
- Issue-form test: expect mcc-server (current form command).

  parse the extracted pattern in the contract test.
